subject: Vendr portal: upload governance, presign TTL, and role ownership
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: S3 presign / upload governance questions

Hi Alex / Jordan,

Thanks for starting the Vendor Portal onboarding checklist for Redwood. Were finalizing the presigned upload flow for evidence ingestion and want to confirm a couple of governance items so we map them into Vendr's inventory. Quick items below — if you prefer a short call we can take this live.

1) Presign TTL: what maximum TTL should we set for presigned URLs (in seconds)? We usually default to 3600s, but customers sometimes require shorter lived URLs for SOC2/CAIQ evidence artifacts.

2) Upload ownership: which Redwood role(s) should own the upload process (service-account vs human operator)? Please indicate the canonical owner for audit logs and access reviews.

3) KMS key: are uploads encrypted with a customer-managed KMS or our default vendor-managed key? If customer-managed, can you confirm key alias and a contact for rotation notices.

4) Evidence retention / TTL: when Vendr auto-archives items into long-term storage, do we trigger any additional proofs or signatures (e.g., hash manifest) you require for proof-of-possession?

If you can reply with the answers and any existing policy doc, well stub the portal settings and send a pre-populated CAIQ mapping.

Thanks,

Ida Petrova
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
onboarding@vendr.com
(attachment: onboarding-checklist-v2.pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: S3 presign / upload governance questions

On Tue, Aug 21, 2028 at 09:12 Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex / Jordan,
>
> Thanks for starting the Vendor Portal onboarding checklist for Redwood. Were finalizing the presigned upload flow for evidence ingestion and want to confirm a couple of governance items so we map them into Vendr's inventory. Quick items below — if you prefer a short call we can take this live.

Hi Ida — thanks for the clear list. Answers below, and I attached a one-page draft policy (vendr-presign-policy-draft.docx) and our role matrix CSV so you can load defaults into Vendr.

1) Presign TTL: default 1 hour (3600s). For SOC2 evidence we prefer 300s for high-sensitivity proofs and 1800s for larger non-sensitive bundles. Were OK with you exposing a granular TTL field in the portal but would like to enforce max=3600s server-side.

2) Upload ownership: prefer a service account (redwood-vendr-uploader@redwood-svc) to perform the backend presign requests. Human operators (security_ops@redwood.com) should only be allowed to trigger manual re-uploads via the console and will be scoped via short-lived role elevation. Please map the service account as the canonical owner for audit logs. See role matrix in the attachment (redwood-role-matrix-v1.csv).

3) KMS key: we use a customer-managed AWS KMS key for evidence buckets: alias/aws/redwood-evidence (key rotation is quarterly). Primary contact for rotation: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com).

4) Evidence retention / TTL: we require a SHA256 manifest appended at time of ingest for any evidence archived beyond 90 days. That manifest must be signed by the service account and retained in the same bucket. If Vendr will perform archival, please ensure you preserve the object metadata (x-amz-meta-proof-hash).

Next steps:
- Please import the attached CSV to provision roles.
- Set presign_max_seconds = 3600 and allow TTL_override but capped.
- We'll share a short SOC2 evidence mapping doc; can you reserve time Wed 8/22 for a 30-min sync to validate portal settings? I can loop in security_ops.

Thanks,

Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
(attachments: vendr-presign-policy-draft.docx; redwood-role-matrix-v1.csv)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: S3 presign / upload governance questions

Thanks Alex / Ida — a few clarifications from the security team: 

- For auditability we need all presign events logged with requestor identity and the requestors IP where possible. If Vendr cannot capture IP reliably, ensure the service account exchange includes a short-lived credential that logs the initiating user in the request metadata.

- Rotation cadence: Marcus, can you confirm quarterly rotation is ok for Vendr to rely on, and please add a calendar invite rule so Vendr can send a rotation notification to the key contact 14 days before rotate.

- CAIQ mapping: When you send the CAIQ fragment, please mark fields that change behaviorally depending on TTL (for example, evidence ingestion vs ephemeral debug artifacts). Well need that for our SOC2 control owners.

One more ask: if Vendr supports pre-signed POST vs GET, prefer POST for larger artifacts (improved integrity on multipart). Please include a setting toggle for POST mode.

Jordan Blake
Security Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

On a related note, Marcus — can you own the KMS rotation contact and confirm the alias?

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: S3 presign / upload governance questions

Ida / team — thanks for the fast turn. Were good to proceed with the following items and will expect Vendr to mirror these in the portal defaults: 

- presign_max_seconds = 3600 (enforced server-side)
- sensitive_evidence_presign_seconds = 300 (overrideable only by named security roles)
- allow_presign_post = true (default off for projects, opt-in per account)
- service account redwood-vendr-uploader@redwood-svc is canonical owner for uploads and will sign ingest manifests
- KMS alias: alias/aws/redwood-evidence, rotation contact: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com)
- Archive manifest: SHA256 stored as x-amz-meta-proof-hash and attached manifest file retained for 2 years

Ive scheduled a 30-min sync: Wed 08/22 14:00 PT (invite sent). Agenda is: portal settings confirmation, CSV import check, and CAIQ fragment review. If you need to adjust the time, let me know.

Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(see attached policy draft and role matrix)
